cases.notes: Dedicated r185 single-sample implementation: one TorusKnot InstancedMesh entity with 50 instances, one Scene RenderSet, Depth32Float attachment, and the original depth-linearization fullscreen shader. The reachable MSAA control is intentionally fixed to zero samples and is not simulated. Strict evidence: 24/24 quadrant runs, 24/24 cross-quadrant comparisons, and 16/16 stability comparisons passed; worst MAE 0.04777, P99 1, and SSIM 0.999461054205724.
